Este rol resuelve los problemas que no son del agente conversacional ni de la plataforma core, sino de la capa intermedia que conecta a Vozy con el cliente. Sin este trabajo, los agentes que despliegan los FDEs simplemente no llegan al usuario final.

• Configurar, migrar y sostener troncales SIP de clientes y de Vozy : esquemas de carrier global, carrier por cuenta, troncales por Internet y por VPN.

• Diagnosticar fallas de marcación y de audio con trazas SIP y capturas de paquetes: rechazos por código 480, congestión de circuito, timeouts de timbrado, transferencias sin respuesta, invites duplicados sobre una misma llamada, audio que llega degradado desde el carrier.

• Gestionar DIDs, prefijos, enmascaramiento y matrices de enrutamiento por país, y validar por qué ruta entra el tráfico antes de configurar.

• Interlocutor directamente con carriers y con los equipos de telefonía de los clientes hasta el cierre del caso, con evidencia técnica en la mano.

• Sostener pruebas de telefonía en ventanas acordadas con cliente, incluyendo pruebas por país, numeración local y reversión de troncal al terminar.

2. Activaciones e integraciones

• Ejecutar la activación técnica de clientes nuevos: troncal SIP, conectividad, VPN, listas de IP, webhooks, SFTP y buckets de almacenamiento.

• Provisionar y migrar canales de mensajería: creación de cuenta con el proveedor de WhatsApp Business API, conexión con el Business Manager del cliente, onboarding de números y validación de saldo y estado de cuenta.

• Validar integraciones con las centrales telefónicas y contact centers del cliente, y armar la lista de chequeo de requisitos técnicos antes de cada integración.

3. Soporte y escalamiento

• Ser el primer punto de escalación técnica para FDEs y clientes en temas de telefonía e integraciones.

• Triage de tickets: exigir la información mínima (identificador de sesión, cuenta, agente, campaña, fecha y hora, evidencia) antes de investigar, y devolver lo que llegue incompleto.

• Escalar a Platform e infraestructura con contexto y propuesta, nunca con un "algo no funciona": qué falla, en qué cuenta, qué se descartó y cuál es la hipótesis.

• Sostener la operación durante incidentes que afectan a varias cuentas a la vez, coordinando comunicación con FDEs y liderazgo.

4. Monitoreo y prevención

• Construir y operar monitoreo proactivo de la capa técnica: tableros de llamadas rechazadas por cuenta, estado de troncales, saldo de canales, salud de los flujos.

• Anticipar problemas recurrentes y proponer solución preventiva. Hoy varios incidentes se detectan porque el cliente los reporta, no por alerta propia. Cerrar esa brecha es parte del rol.

• Automatizar detección y respuesta a degradación, no solo alertar.

5. Documentación y formación

• Mantener runbooks de soporte técnico y activaciones para los escenarios más comunes.

• Entrenar a FDEs en troubleshooting básico de telefonía e integraciones, con sesiones prácticas sobre casos reales.

Kodland 's goal is to prepare children for the future. We help them acquire skills that set them up to succeed in their careers and develop their interests. Kodland operates in 40 countries and educates over 30,000 students.

An Online Tutor who would be responsible for:

• Delivering fun and engaging lessons based on the provided scripts and materials

• Improving their teaching skills with the help of experienced Kodland mentors

• Communicating any feedback regarding lessons and class content to the office team

• Providing regular and detailed reports on student progress, and tracking and improving class engagement and the learning experience

• Being a positive, influential, and open ambassador for Kodland

• Implementing creative ideas to stimulate and support our students

45K - 65K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

• No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

• Typically, clinicians work between Mondays - Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
